foreground_english.en: A couple of years ago in the French Open final, when he had the tape — as we see this exchange…
foreground_english.zh:

foreground_english.en: Usually so efficient up at the net — not this time.
foreground_english.zh: 他网前一向高效——这次没有。

foreground_english.en: Off the tape — Thiem spreads his hand in apology.
foreground_english.zh: （擦带爬过——蒂姆随即摊手致歉）

foreground_english.en: He actually had the tape under his sweat bands, as they get the apology there…
foreground_english.zh:
胶带就缠在汗带下面
看，致歉来了。

foreground_english.en: …to try and keep them in place, because they were slipping down — so heavy with sweat.
foreground_english.zh:
怕汗带浸重了往下滑
才缠在里面。
